lessons.titleEn: in the hands of only a few

target.pattern: \bin the hands of only a few(?: people)?\b

brief.meaningEn: Controlled or accessible chiefly by a small group.
brief.meaningZh: 主要由少數人控制或接觸。
brief.grammar: Use be or remain in the hands of only a few with information, decisions or resources as subject; the hands are metaphorical.
brief.register: Education, governance and workplace discussion about unequal access or control.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是掌握權集中在少數人；不表示這些人一定有能力，也不必指字面握在手中。
brief.misconceptionZh: 「由合適的人管理」談能力，不等於「只由少數人掌握」談集中程度。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出知識或決策權是否集中，以及誰被排除在外。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 149, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Knowledge stays in the hands of only a few people without teaching.
sources.expression: stays in the hands of only a few people

listening.en: At the archive, three senior curators alone can read the restoration notes. Until the notes are shared, the method remains in the hands of only a few.
listening.zh: 檔案館只有三位資深修復員能閱讀修復筆記。筆記未公開前，修復方法仍只由少數人掌握。
listening.promptZh: 修復方法目前由誰掌握？

options.en: Only three senior curators can consult the notes.
options.zh: 目前只有三位資深修復員可以查閱筆記。

options.en: Every trainee can consult the notes independently.
options.zh: 每位學徒都可以自行查閱筆記。

options.en: The notes have been lost, so nobody can use them.
options.zh: 筆記已遺失，因此沒有人能使用。

options.en: Visitors can buy copies of the notes at reception.
options.zh: 訪客可在接待處購買筆記副本。

listening.explanationZh: 只有三位修復員可查閱筆記，正是知識集中於少數人。

reply.promptZh: 誰能決定誰可以查閱這些研究資料？

options.en: A small committee currently controls access to the records.
options.zh: 目前由一個小型委員會控制資料的查閱權。

options.en: The committee makes every decision about who may consult the records.
options.zh: 委員會決定誰可以查閱這些資料。

options.en: The records are in the hands of only a few until the committee opens them.
options.zh: 在委員會開放資料前，資料只由少數人掌握。

options.en: Only the three committee members can approve access requests at present.
options.zh: 目前只有三名委員會成員可以批准查閱申請。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均可自然回應誰掌握及如何開放資料；金句使用本課表達概括目前的集中狀態。
reply.promptEn: Who controls access to the research records?

scene.promptZh: 一間社區電台只有兩名員工持有節目製作指南，其他志願者想接受培訓。哪句最完整說明問題？

options.en: The guide is in the hands of only a few, so volunteers cannot yet learn the process.
options.zh: 指南只由少數人掌握，因此志願者暫時無法學習製作流程。

options.en: The two employees should choose a convenient day for training.
options.zh: 兩名員工應選個方便的日子進行培訓。

options.en: Volunteers need enough time to practise once they receive the guide.
options.zh: 志願者收到指南後需要足夠時間練習。

scene.explanationZh: 後兩句提出合理的培訓安排，卻未點明指南目前集中在兩人手中。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合「只由少數人掌握」？

options.en: A board keeps the budget figures confidential from most members.
options.zh: 董事會向大部分成員保密預算數字。

options.en: The library posts its research manual online for everyone to read.
options.zh: 圖書館把研究手冊上載到網上，供所有人閱讀。

options.en: Three managers alone can approve changes to the schedule.
options.zh: 只有三名經理可批准更改時間表。

contrast.explanationZh: 手冊向所有人公開，並非只有少數人能接觸。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「這套維修方法怎麼只有主管知道？」你知道兩名主管保管所有步驟，而且尚未安排傳授。哪句最合適？

options.en: The method is in the hands of only a few; we should ask for a shared guide.
options.zh: 這套方法只由少數人掌握；我們應要求提供共用指南。

options.en: The supervisors might be able to arrange a training session next month.
options.zh: 主管或許能在下月安排培訓。

options.en: We should first ask whether the repair steps have been written down.
options.zh: 我們應先問維修步驟是否已有書面記錄。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句提出合理下一步；金句還指出眼前的資訊集中問題。

speaking.en: The maintenance procedure is in the hands of only a few until the guide is shared.
speaking.zh: 在指南公開前，維修程序只由少數人掌握。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，說出甚麼資訊尚未向更多人開放。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一所學校只有校務委員會三人看得到獎學金評分準則，申請學生無法知道標準。用一至兩句英文說明這個資訊分配問題及一項可行改善。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出準則由少數人掌握及學生被排除；可提出公開準則，不要說委員的能力有問題。

examples.en: The scoring criteria are in the hands of only a few committee members, so applicants cannot see how decisions are made.
examples.zh: 評分準則只由少數委員掌握，因此申請人看不到決定如何作出。

examples.en: Publishing the criteria would end a system in which scholarship rules remain in the hands of only a few.
examples.zh: 公開準則可改變獎學金規則只由少數人掌握的制度。

takeaways.en: The records stayed in the hands of only a few until the team created a public guide.
takeaways.zh: 團隊製作公開指南前，資料一直只由少數人掌握。

takeaways.en: Expertise may be valuable, but it should not remain in the hands of only a few when others need to learn.
takeaways.zh: 專業知識固然有價值，但其他人需要學習時，不應只由少數人掌握。

brief.meaningEn: Fundamentally change accepted practices or conventions.
brief.meaningZh: 根本改變人們既有的做法或慣例。
brief.grammar: Use rewrite the rules metaphorically with an innovation, policy or group as subject; specify the domain being changed.
brief.register: Analysis of technology, sport, work or society where established practices shift.
brief.boundaryZh: 指慣例或運作方式的重大變化；不一定指正式法規逐條改寫。
brief.misconceptionZh: 一項新工具只是加快舊流程，未必足以說它改寫了規則。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體前後差異說明一項發展如何改變既有做法。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 158, row 4; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Digital communication is rewriting the rules of society.

listening.en: The town used to require every shop to close at six. After a cooperative introduced shared late deliveries, evening markets became normal. The cooperative rewrote the rules for local trading.
listening.zh: 這個小鎮原本規定所有商店六時關門。合作社推出共同晚間送貨後，夜市變得普遍；它改寫了本地營商的既有做法。

options.en: It changed what local shops normally do in the evening.
options.zh: 它改變了本地商店晚間的慣常做法。

options.en: It merely printed the old shop rules in a new font.
options.zh: 它只是以新字體印出舊店規。

options.en: It closed the evening markets permanently.
options.zh: 它永久關閉了夜市。

options.en: It changed only the colour of delivery boxes.
options.zh: 它只改變了送貨箱的顏色。

listening.explanationZh: 晚間營商由不可能變成常態，屬既有做法的重大改變。

reply.promptZh: 新系統對社區診所有甚麼影響？

options.en: It lets patients book visits after office hours.
options.zh: 它讓病人在辦公時間後預約診症。

options.en: It rewrites the rules for access by allowing evening appointments.
options.zh: 它透過開放晚間預約，改寫了求診方式的既有規則。

options.en: It may reduce the morning queue.
options.zh: 它或許可縮短早上的輪候隊伍。

options.en: It gives working patients a way to book without taking time off during the day.
options.zh: 它讓在職病人不用在日間請假，也能預約診症。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均回應診所新系統的影響；金句用本課表達概括求診慣例的轉變。
reply.promptEn: What difference does the new system make for the community clinic?

scene.promptZh: 一家出版社原本只接受紙本稿件，現在讓讀者在線上提出修改建議，作者亦可逐週回應。哪句最完整描述這項轉變？

options.en: The publisher rewrote the rules for collaboration between writers and readers.
options.zh: 出版社改寫了作者與讀者協作的既有方式。

options.en: Readers can now send comments more quickly.
options.zh: 讀者現在能更快提交意見。

options.en: Authors should check reader comments each week.
options.zh: 作者應每週查看讀者意見。

scene.explanationZh: 後兩句是具體影響或建議；金句概括了作者與讀者角色關係的變化。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項變化最不足以說是 rewrite the rules？

options.en: A league replaces fixed team rosters with open transfers throughout the season.
options.zh: 聯賽把固定名單改成賽季期間可隨時轉會。

options.en: A school lets pupils design parts of the timetable instead of receiving a fixed one.
options.zh: 學校讓學生參與編排部分時間表，而非只接受固定安排。

options.en: A shop keeps the same opening hours but changes the colour of its signs.
options.zh: 商店營業時間不變，只更換招牌顏色。

contrast.explanationZh: 招牌顏色改變外觀，沒有改變運作慣例。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這個互助托兒計劃只是不一樣的廣告嗎？」你知道家長可互換照顧時段，改變了原本只能付費預約的安排。哪句最合適？

options.en: It rewrites the rules of childcare access by letting families exchange time.
options.zh: 它讓家庭互換照顧時段，改寫了取得托兒服務的既有方式。

options.en: Families should check each other’s available hours carefully.
options.zh: 家庭應仔細核對彼此可用的時段。

options.en: The programme may give some parents a cheaper option.
options.zh: 這計劃或許為部分家長提供較便宜的選擇。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句合理，但金句指出取得托兒服務的慣例如何改變。

speaking.en: The exchange programme rewrites the rules for borrowing tools in this neighbourhood.
speaking.zh: 互借計劃改寫了這個社區借用工具的既有方式。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，說明被改變的是哪一項既有做法。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區圖書館原本只容許館員選書，現在讀者可在線上提名並投票決定每月新增書目。用一至兩句英文描述這項改變。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明原有選書權和新參與方式的前後差異；不要把比喻說成改寫法律。

examples.en: Reader voting rewrites the rules for choosing new books, because the decision no longer belongs only to librarians.
examples.zh: 讀者投票改寫了選購新書的既有方式，因為決定權不再只屬館員。

examples.en: The library has rewritten the rules of book selection by inviting readers to nominate titles each month.
examples.zh: 圖書館邀請讀者每月提名書目，從而改寫了選書方式。

takeaways.en: A small design tweak rarely rewrites the rules of an entire industry.
takeaways.zh: 一項小設計調整很少會改寫整個行業的慣例。

takeaways.en: The shared workshop rewrote the rules for who could use expensive equipment.
takeaways.zh: 共用工作坊改寫了誰能使用昂貴設備的既有安排。

brief.meaningEn: Impress people strongly, often through a striking display or presentation.
brief.meaningZh: 以鮮明的展示或表現令人留下深刻印象。
brief.grammar: Use dazzle people as a transitive verb phrase; for a moment may limit duration but is not part of the verb meaning.
brief.register: Product demonstrations, performances or presentations where striking first impressions matter.
brief.boundaryZh: 可以短暫或持久；本課要分清「令人驚艷」與「確實有長期價值」。
brief.misconceptionZh: dazzle 不表示產品有效、內容準確，亦不必然只維持一瞬間。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出某事吸引眼球的效果，同時不把印象等同實際成效。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 160, row 13; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A flashy feature may dazzle people for a moment.

listening.en: At the science fair, the model bridge lit up and moved in perfect rhythm. It dazzled people during the demonstration, although the judges still had to test its strength.
listening.zh: 科學展的模型橋亮起燈光，並以整齊節奏移動。示範時它令人驚艷，但評審仍須測試橋的承重能力。
listening.promptZh: 模型橋的示範產生了甚麼效果？

options.en: Its striking display strongly impressed the audience.
options.zh: 搶眼的展示令觀眾留下深刻印象。

options.en: The judges had already proved the bridge was safe.
options.zh: 評審已證實橋樑安全。

options.en: The model failed to move during the demonstration.
options.zh: 模型在示範時無法移動。

options.en: The lights made the bridge cheaper to build.
options.zh: 燈光使橋樑建造成本下降。

listening.explanationZh: dazzled 指展示令人印象深刻，不等於已證明結構安全。

reply.promptZh: 你覺得新展覽的開幕表演怎樣？

options.en: The lights are bright enough for the stage.
options.zh: 燈光足夠照亮舞台。

options.en: The performers dazzle people with their precise timing.
options.zh: 表演者以準確的節奏令人驚艷。

options.en: The opening draws a large crowd.
options.zh: 開幕表演吸引了大批觀眾。

options.en: The museum should keep the performance on weekends.
options.zh: 博物館應在週末保留這場表演。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均可自然回應開幕表演；金句直接用本課表達描述強烈印象。
reply.promptEn: What did you think of the exhibition opening?

scene.promptZh: 一家初創公司以流暢動畫展示新翻譯器，但尚未公布準確率。哪句最完整描述目前可以確定的效果？

options.en: The presentation dazzles people, but the translation accuracy remains untested.
options.zh: 展示令人驚艷，但翻譯準確率仍未經測試。

options.en: The translator is accurate enough for legal documents.
options.zh: 翻譯器已足夠準確，可處理法律文件。

options.en: The animation explains how the translator was trained.
options.zh: 動畫說明翻譯器如何受訓。

scene.explanationZh: 動畫帶來強烈印象，但不能據此推斷翻譯準確。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把 dazzle people 誤當成已證明實際品質？

options.en: The light show dazzled people, though the exhibit remained informative.
options.zh: 燈光表演令人驚艷，而展覽內容亦富資訊性。

options.en: The polished trailer dazzled people, so the unfinished app must already be reliable.
options.zh: 精美預告片令人驚艷，因此未完成的應用程式必然可靠。

options.en: The violin solo dazzled people and drew applause.
options.zh: 小提琴獨奏令人驚艷，贏得掌聲。

contrast.explanationZh: 令人驚艷只說明觀感，不能證明未完成的應用程式可靠。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「影片一播，大家都鼓掌，所以我們可以跳過產品測試嗎？」你認為展示確實搶眼，但測試仍要做。哪句最合適？

options.en: The video may dazzle people, but we still need to test the product.
options.zh: 影片或許令人驚艷，但我們仍須測試產品。

options.en: We should write down which part of the video people liked.
options.zh: 我們應記下大家喜歡影片的哪一部分。

options.en: The applause suggests the opening caught their attention.
options.zh: 掌聲顯示開場吸引了他們的注意。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句合理，但金句同時指出搶眼印象和產品測試是兩回事。

speaking.en: The colourful prototype can dazzle people before anyone checks how well it works.
speaking.zh: 色彩鮮明的原型可以先令人驚艷，即使大家尚未檢查它的效能。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，分辨視覺效果與實際效能。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校推出一段令人驚艷的機械人表演，但比賽前仍需要測試電池續航力。用一至兩句英文說明目前的觀感與仍待驗證之處。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出表演如何吸引觀眾，也要保留電池測試這項未決事項；不要說 dazzle 必然短暫。

examples.en: The robot display dazzled people at the assembly, but the team still needs to test its battery life.
examples.zh: 機械人在集會上的展示令人驚艷，但團隊仍須測試電池續航力。

examples.en: Bright movements may dazzle people during the show; they do not prove the robot can run for an hour.
examples.zh: 鮮明的動作或許令觀眾在表演時眼前一亮，卻不能證明機械人可運作一小時。

takeaways.en: A polished slide can dazzle people without answering their practical questions.
takeaways.zh: 精美的投影片可以令人驚艷，卻未必回答實際問題。

takeaways.en: A clear experiment may dazzle people and still withstand careful testing.
takeaways.zh: 清晰的實驗既可能令人驚艷，也可能經得起仔細檢驗。

brief.meaningEn: Substantially alter a person or group’s future prospects.
brief.meaningZh: 大幅改變某人或某群體未來的境況。
brief.grammar: Use change the fate of with a person or group as complement; the effect must plausibly alter long-term prospects.
brief.register: Historical, medical, educational or civic analysis of consequential developments.
brief.boundaryZh: 需要足以影響長遠機會或生存境況的轉變；微小方便或短期喜好通常不足。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這個說法不必暗示宿命，也不代表結果一定是好事；須交代改變的方向。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體後果支持「改變命運」的強度。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 161, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Public health has changed the fate of millions.

listening.en: A rural clinic began treating an infection that had previously left many children disabled. The new treatment changed the fate of families who once faced lifelong care costs.
listening.zh: 一所鄉郊診所開始治療一種過去令不少兒童殘障的感染。新療法改變了原本面對終身照護開支的家庭的境況。
listening.promptZh: 新療法的影響為何如此重大？

options.en: It altered families’ long-term health and financial prospects.
options.zh: 它改變了家庭長遠的健康及經濟前景。

options.en: It changed only the colour of the clinic walls.
options.zh: 它只改變了診所牆壁顏色。

options.en: It moved one appointment to a later afternoon.
options.zh: 它把一次診症改到較後的下午。

options.en: It removed the need for every kind of medical care.
options.zh: 它消除了對所有醫療服務的需要。

listening.explanationZh: 療法影響長期健康與經濟前景，才足以用強烈說法描述。

reply.promptZh: （助學計劃支付交通費和學費後，幾名偏遠地區學生完成中學並升讀大學。這項計劃怎樣影響他們的前途？）

options.en: It gave some students a chance to finish secondary school.
options.zh: 它讓部分學生有機會完成中學。

options.en: It reduced their cost of travelling to school.
options.zh: 它減輕了他們往返學校的交通費負擔。

options.en: It changed the fate of several students by helping them finish school and enter college.
options.zh: 它幫助幾名學生完成學業並升讀大學，改變了他們的前途。

options.en: It opened a path to college for students who had struggled to pay school costs.
options.zh: 它為原本難以負擔學費的學生打開升讀大學的道路。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均可自然談計劃影響；金句以本課表達概括長遠教育前途的變化。
reply.promptEn: After the scholarship covered travel and fees, several remote students finished secondary school and entered college. How did it affect their prospects?

scene.promptZh: 一個防洪工程讓原本每年被迫撤離的村民可以長期安居。哪句最完整描述影響？

options.en: The project changed the fate of families who had repeatedly lost their homes.
options.zh: 工程改變了屢次失去家園的家庭的境況。

options.en: The project finished before the rainy season began.
options.zh: 工程在雨季開始前完工。

options.en: Families need clear instructions during storms.
options.zh: 家庭在暴風雨期間需要清楚指引。

scene.explanationZh: 後兩句有關工程和安全，但只有金句點出長遠居住前景的重大改變。

contrast.promptZh: 哪項事情最不足以說 change the fate of 一群人？

options.en: A vaccine prevents a previously fatal disease in a region.
options.zh: 疫苗在某地區預防一種原本致命的疾病。

options.en: A court decision restores a displaced group’s right to return home.
options.zh: 法院裁決恢復流離失所者返回家園的權利。

options.en: A café changes the colour of its takeaway cups for one week.
options.zh: 咖啡店把外賣杯顏色更改一星期。

contrast.explanationZh: 外賣杯顏色變動對人們的長遠境況沒有相稱影響。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「這條新渡輪航線真的有那麼重要嗎？」你知道它讓島上學生全年可上學，而過去雨季常停課。哪句最合適？

options.en: It could change the fate of island students by making regular schooling possible.
options.zh: 它讓島上學生能穩定上學，可能改變他們的前途。

options.en: The ferry timetable should be easy for families to understand.
options.zh: 渡輪時間表應方便家庭理解。

options.en: We should compare attendance before and after the route opens.
options.zh: 我們應比較航線開通前後的出席率。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句是有用的實施或評估建議；金句點出穩定教育對未來的重大影響。

speaking.en: Reliable transport can change the fate of pupils who used to miss months of school.
speaking.zh: 可靠交通可改變昔日經常缺課數月的學生的前途。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，指出哪項長遠機會受到影響。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一項飲用水工程讓偏遠村落不再常因水源污染而爆發疾病，兒童能穩定上學。用一至兩句英文說明為何這不只是小方便。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出健康和上學的長遠變化；不要只說工程外觀或短期省時。

examples.en: Clean water could change the fate of village children by reducing illness and keeping them in school.
examples.zh: 潔淨食水能減少疾病，讓村中兒童持續上學，從而改變他們的前途。

examples.en: The water system changed the fate of families who previously lost work and school days to repeated outbreaks.
examples.zh: 供水系統改變了過去因反覆疫症而失去工作及上學日子的家庭的境況。

takeaways.en: A lasting chance to study can change the fate of a child more than a one-day gift.
takeaways.zh: 長遠的求學機會比一天的禮物更可能改變一名孩子的前途。

takeaways.en: Medical access changed the fate of patients who once had no effective treatment.
takeaways.zh: 醫療服務改變了昔日得不到有效治療的病人的境況。

brief.meaningEn: Submit a request to buy goods or services.
brief.meaningZh: 提交購買商品或服務的訂單。
brief.grammar: Use place an order with a buyer as subject; a shop may receive or fulfil the order later.
brief.register: Everyday retail, restaurant and online purchasing.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是買方提交訂單；付款、確認、出貨和收貨可能是後續不同步驟。
brief.misconceptionZh: 「落單」不等於已收到貨，也不等於店家已接受訂單。
brief.outcomeZh: 能分辨提交訂單與確認、付款、交付的不同時點。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 167, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Customers can place an order from their phones.

listening.en: Mia selected two notebooks and entered her delivery address. When she pressed the final checkout button, she placed an order; the shop will confirm it by email.
listening.zh: 美雅選了兩本筆記簿並輸入送貨地址。她按下最後的結帳按鈕時便落單，商店稍後會以電郵確認。
listening.promptZh: 美雅甚麼時候提交了購買要求？

options.en: When she pressed the final checkout button.
options.zh: 她按下最後的結帳按鈕時。

options.en: When she first looked at the notebook pictures.
options.zh: 她首次查看筆記簿圖片時。

options.en: Only when the parcel arrived at her door.
options.zh: 只有包裹送到家門時。

options.en: Only after the shop sent a discount advertisement.
options.zh: 只有商店發出折扣廣告後。

listening.explanationZh: 最後結帳按鈕提交了訂購要求；看圖片或收貨是不同階段。

reply.promptZh: 你怎樣預訂學校活動的午餐？

options.en: I choose a meal and submit the booking form.
options.zh: 我選好餐點，然後提交訂餐表格。

options.en: I place an order through the school app before noon.
options.zh: 我在中午前透過學校應用程式落單。

options.en: I mark the vegetarian option on the request form and hand it in.
options.zh: 我在訂餐表格上選擇素食餐，然後交回表格。

options.en: I submit my lunch request at the school office before the deadline.
options.zh: 我在截止時間前到學校辦公室提交午餐預訂。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均自然描述訂餐流程；金句直接用本課表達說明提交訂單。
reply.promptEn: How do you book lunch for the school event?

scene.promptZh: 一家麵包店的網站容許顧客選蛋糕、填地址，然後按「提交」。哪句最準確說明按鍵的作用？

options.en: Customers place an order when they submit the completed form.
options.zh: 顧客提交已填妥的表格時便落單。

options.en: Customers can compare cake sizes before submitting the form.
options.zh: 顧客可在提交表格前比較蛋糕大小。

options.en: The bakery can prepare deliveries after receiving the form.
options.zh: 麵包店收到表格後可安排送貨。

scene.explanationZh: 比較與備貨也是流程的一部分，金句明確指出顧客何時提出購買要求。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最清楚地把「落單」和「已收貨」混為一談？

options.en: He placed an order on Monday and collected it on Wednesday.
options.zh: 他星期一落單，星期三取貨。

options.en: She placed an order, but the shop has not confirmed it yet.
options.zh: 她已落單，但商店尚未確認。

options.en: Because I placed an order, the package must already be in my hands.
options.zh: 因為我已落單，包裹必定已在我手中。

contrast.explanationZh: 提交訂單不保證貨品已送達。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我把書放進購物籃了，是否已經買下？」你看到他還未按最後的提交按鈕。哪句最合適？

options.en: You still need to place an order at checkout; the basket alone does not submit it.
options.zh: 你仍須在結帳時落單；只放進購物籃不算提交訂單。

options.en: You can review the price before completing checkout.
options.zh: 你可在完成結帳前再核對價格。

options.en: The shop may email you after checkout is complete.
options.zh: 完成結帳後，商店或會向你發電郵。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句合理，但金句明確回答購物籃與正式落單的差別。

speaking.en: You place an order when you submit the purchase request, not when you open the shopping page.
speaking.zh: 你提交購買要求時才算落單，打開購物頁面並不算。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，指出哪個動作真正提交了訂單。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：你替班級訂印刷海報，已選數量但尚未按網站的「確認訂購」。用一至兩句英文告訴老師目前進度及下一步。
writing.selfCheckZh: 清楚區分選擇數量和正式提交；不要說海報已交付。

examples.en: I have chosen the poster quantity, but I still need to place an order by pressing the confirmation button.
examples.zh: 我已選好海報數量，但仍須按確認按鈕才正式落單。

examples.en: We can place an order after the teacher checks the final design and delivery address.
examples.zh: 老師核對最後設計和送貨地址後，我們便可落單。

takeaways.en: Saving an item in a basket is different from placing an order.
takeaways.zh: 把商品儲存在購物籃，不等於正式落單。

takeaways.en: The club placed an order for thirty badges and is waiting for confirmation.
takeaways.zh: 學會訂購了三十枚徽章，正等待確認。

brief.meaningEn: Attract people strongly to a place or activity.
brief.meaningZh: 強烈吸引人們前往某地或參與某事。
brief.grammar: Use pull people in like magnets with a plural attractor; singular subjects more naturally take like a magnet.
brief.register: Describing urban opportunities, cultural events or other strong draws.
brief.boundaryZh: 比喻吸引力，並非字面磁力；應指出吸引人的具體原因，不要推斷所有人都會來。
brief.misconceptionZh: 有工作機會能吸引人，卻不等於每個人都已搬去或必然留下。
brief.outcomeZh: 能將吸引力與造成吸引的因素連起來，並保持主謂及單複數自然。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 174, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Large cities pull people in like magnets.
sources.expression: cities pull people in like magnets

listening.en: Two coastal towns opened year-round arts studios and affordable flats. Those combined opportunities pull people in like magnets, though not every visitor decides to move.
listening.zh: 兩個沿海小鎮開設全年開放的藝術工作室，亦提供較相宜的住宅。這些機會像磁石般吸引人，但並非每名訪客都決定遷居。

options.en: They offer studios and homes that many people want.
options.zh: 它們提供許多人想要的工作室和住宅。

options.en: Every visitor is legally required to settle there.
options.zh: 每名訪客都依法必須在當地定居。

options.en: The towns contain literal magnets beneath the roads.
options.zh: 小鎮的道路底下有真正的磁石。

options.en: The studios are open only one day each year.
options.zh: 工作室每年只開放一天。

listening.explanationZh: 藝術與居住機會構成吸引力；磁石只是比喻。

reply.promptZh: 新開的文化區怎樣影響週末人流？

options.en: Its performances draw a large weekend crowd.
options.zh: 它的演出吸引大批週末人流。

options.en: The cafés may encourage visitors to stay longer.
options.zh: 咖啡店或會讓訪客停留更久。

options.en: The galleries and food stalls pull people in like magnets.
options.zh: 畫廊和美食攤檔像磁石般吸引人。

options.en: Its free workshops bring more families into the district on Saturdays.
options.zh: 免費工作坊令更多家庭在星期六來到文化區。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可自然談週末人流；金句使用本課比喻概括多項吸引因素。
reply.promptEn: How does the new cultural district affect weekend crowds?

scene.promptZh: 兩個鄉村在採果季開放農場參觀及短期住宿，附近家庭常專程前往。哪句最完整概括吸引力？

options.en: The farms and guesthouses pull people in like magnets during harvest.
options.zh: 採收季期間，農場和民宿像磁石般吸引人。

options.en: Families can book short stays near the orchards.
options.zh: 家庭可在果園附近預訂短期住宿。

options.en: The villages should check bus schedules before the season.
options.zh: 村莊應在採收季前檢查巴士班次。

scene.explanationZh: 後兩句說明安排或建議；金句把農場和住宿吸引人前往的作用概括出來。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句把吸引力比喻誤讀為字面作用？

options.en: The music venues pull people in like magnets because they offer free concerts.
options.zh: 音樂場地因提供免費音樂會而像磁石般吸引人。

options.en: The market stalls pull people in like magnets, so there must be metal under the pavement.
options.zh: 市集攤檔像磁石般吸引人，所以路面底下必定有金屬。

options.en: The markets pull people in like magnets when local growers bring fresh fruit.
options.zh: 本地農夫帶來新鮮水果時，市集像磁石般吸引人。

contrast.explanationZh: 比喻說的是人願意前往，不證明路面有金屬。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「為甚麼兩間新書店每逢週末都有人排隊？」你知道兩店提供免費講座和兒童閱讀角。哪句最合適？

options.en: Their talks and reading corners pull people in like magnets at weekends.
options.zh: 它們的講座和閱讀角每逢週末都像磁石般吸引人。

options.en: Families can check the talk times before visiting.
options.zh: 家庭可在到訪前查看講座時間。

options.en: The shops may need longer weekend opening hours.
options.zh: 書店或許需要延長週末營業時間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句是合理建議；金句直接解釋了來客的吸引因素。

speaking.en: Free workshops and affordable studios pull people in like magnets during the festival.
speaking.zh: 免費工作坊和相宜的工作室在節日期間像磁石般吸引人。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，說出具體吸引人的項目。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：兩個郊區公園新增安全單車道及免費周末活動，更多家庭願意前往。用一至兩句英文描述原因，避免說每個家庭都會去。
writing.selfCheckZh: 用複數主語配 like magnets，點出單車道與活動的吸引力，別作絕對預測。

examples.en: The safe cycling paths and free events pull people in like magnets on weekends.
examples.zh: 安全單車道和免費活動在週末像磁石般吸引人。

examples.en: Family rides and outdoor classes pull people in like magnets, although some residents still prefer other plans.
examples.zh: 家庭單車活動和戶外課程像磁石般吸引人，但部分居民仍喜歡其他安排。

takeaways.en: Strong reasons to visit can pull people in like magnets without making them stay.
takeaways.zh: 有力的到訪理由可以像磁石般吸引人，卻不代表他們會留下。

takeaways.en: Shared gardens and evening classes pull people in like magnets from nearby streets.
takeaways.zh: 共用花園和晚間課程像磁石般吸引附近街區的人。

brief.meaningEn: Continue increasing in size or number.
brief.meaningZh: 在規模或數量上持續增加。
brief.grammar: Use keep swelling with a population, crowd, waiting list or other growing total; distinguish figurative growth from physical swelling.
brief.register: Urban planning, service demand and other discussions of continuing growth.
brief.boundaryZh: 描述仍在增加的趨勢；不是單次上升，也不必暗示成長永遠不會停。
brief.misconceptionZh: 身體腫脹是 swell 的字面意思；人口或名單持續增加才是本課比喻用法。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出增加的是甚麼數量，以及造成持續上升的線索。

sources.sentence: The cities keep swelling as jobs concentrate there.

listening.en: A seaside town opened new offices three years ago, and its population has risen every year since. The town keeps swelling as more workers settle nearby.
listening.zh: 一個海邊小鎮三年前開設了新辦公室，此後人口每年上升。隨著更多員工在附近定居，小鎮人口持續增長。
listening.promptZh: 小鎮發生了甚麼持續變化？

options.en: Its population continues to grow.
options.zh: 它的人口持續增加。

options.en: Its population fell after a single busy weekend.
options.zh: 它的人口在一個繁忙週末後下降。

options.en: Its buildings are physically injured and swollen.
options.zh: 它的建築物受傷並出現真正腫脹。

options.en: All new workers have already left the town.
options.zh: 所有新員工都已離開小鎮。

listening.explanationZh: 這裏的 swelling 比喻人口連年增長，並非身體腫脹。

reply.promptZh: 診所的候診名單最近怎樣？

options.en: It has grown each month since the new service began.
options.zh: 新服務推出後，候診名單每月增長。

options.en: The waiting list keeps swelling as referrals arrive faster than appointments open.
options.zh: 轉介個案增加速度快於新增診症名額，候診名單持續擴大。

options.en: It has lengthened even though the clinic added some morning appointments.
options.zh: 雖然診所增加了部分上午診症時段，候診名單仍然變長。

options.en: More patients have joined the list than left it in recent weeks.
options.zh: 近幾星期加入候診名單的病人比離開名單的多。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都與候診有關；金句使用本課表達指出名單仍在變長。
reply.promptEn: What has been happening to the clinic waiting list?

scene.promptZh: 一個社區花園開放新地段後，義工名單連續四個月增加。哪句最完整描述趨勢？

options.en: The volunteer list keeps swelling as more neighbours sign up.
options.zh: 隨著更多街坊報名，義工名單持續增長。

options.en: The garden has opened a new plot this year.
options.zh: 花園今年開放了一塊新地段。

options.en: The organisers should prepare enough tools for volunteers.
options.zh: 主辦者應準備足夠工具供義工使用。

scene.explanationZh: 新地段和工具安排都相關，但只有金句表達連月持續增長。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不屬本課「數量持續增加」的比喻用法？

options.en: The queue kept swelling as each train arrived full.
options.zh: 每班火車都滿載而來，輪候隊伍持續變長。

options.en: The waiting list keeps swelling despite added appointments.
options.zh: 儘管增設診症名額，候診名單仍持續增加。

options.en: Her ankle kept swelling after she twisted it.
options.zh: 她扭傷腳踝後，腳踝持續腫脹。

contrast.explanationZh: 腳踝腫脹是字面身體變化，不是人口、名單或隊伍變大的比喻。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「報名人數是不是只在首日升了一次？」你知道其後每週都有更多家庭加入。哪句最合適？

options.en: The registration list keeps swelling; new families join every week.
options.zh: 報名名單持續增長；每週都有新家庭加入。

options.en: We should count how many families joined on the first day.
options.zh: 我們應統計首日有多少家庭報名。

options.en: The organisers may need a larger room for the next meeting.
options.zh: 主辦者下次開會或許需要更大的房間。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句合理，但金句直接回答增長並非只發生在首日。

speaking.en: The volunteer list keeps swelling because neighbours join after each workshop.
speaking.zh: 每次工作坊後都有街坊加入，義工名單因此持續增長。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，說明增加的是哪個數量。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區廚房每週獲得更多家庭報名，等候名單已連續六週變長。用一至兩句英文向主辦者描述趨勢及原因。
writing.selfCheckZh: 交代六週持續上升及新報名家庭；不要說名單一定永遠增長。

examples.en: The waiting list keeps swelling as more families register for the community kitchen each week.
examples.zh: 每週有更多家庭報名社區廚房，等候名單因而持續增長。

examples.en: Demand keeps swelling after the free cooking sessions attract new neighbourhood groups.
examples.zh: 免費烹飪班吸引新的街坊團體後，需求持續增加。

takeaways.en: The guest list keeps swelling, so the venue may need more seats.
takeaways.zh: 賓客名單持續增長，因此場地或需增加座位。

takeaways.en: Numbers kept swelling for months before the organisers added another session.
takeaways.zh: 主辦者增設另一節活動前，參加人數已持續上升數月。

brief.meaningEn: Start to worsen or decline gradually.
brief.grammar: Use begin to slide with a measurable standard, performance or quality as subject; onset does not assert total collapse.
brief.register: Public-service, economic and organisational analysis of early deterioration.
brief.boundaryZh: 指出變差的早期跡象；不等於已全面崩潰，也不等於字面滑動。
brief.misconceptionZh: 表現下降可有多種程度；不能把一次小波動自動當成確定趨勢。
brief.outcomeZh: 能根據持續跡象描述何時開始惡化，並避免誇大結果。

sources.sentence: If services fail, quality of life begins to slide.
sources.expression: quality of life begins to slide

listening.en: The housing office missed its repair target for three consecutive months, and residents now wait longer. Service quality begins to slide when small delays become routine.
listening.zh: 房屋辦事處連續三個月未達維修目標，居民等候時間也變長。小延誤變成常態時，服務質素便開始下滑。
listening.promptZh: 甚麼跡象顯示服務有變差趨勢？

options.en: Repair targets have been missed repeatedly and waits are longer.
options.zh: 維修目標屢次落空，等候時間也變長。

options.en: One repair finished five minutes early.
options.zh: 一次維修提早五分鐘完成。

options.en: The office moved a chair to another room.
options.zh: 辦事處把椅子搬到另一間房。

options.en: All repairs stopped permanently on the first day.
options.zh: 所有維修在首日便永久停止。

listening.explanationZh: 連續未達標及等候變長支持「開始下滑」，但不表示服務已完全停頓。

reply.promptZh: 最近的巴士服務情況如何？

options.en: The first buses of the day still arrive on time.
options.zh: 每天首班巴士仍準時到達。

options.en: Passengers have reported more missed connections in recent weeks.
options.zh: 近幾星期，乘客反映錯過轉車班次的情況增加。

options.en: Reliability begins to slide when late arrivals become common.
options.zh: 誤點變得普遍時，服務可靠程度便開始下滑。

options.en: More buses have arrived late than they did last term.
options.zh: 相比上學期，現在有更多巴士遲到。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均可自然談服務；金句指出可靠程度開始變差的條件。
reply.promptEn: How has the bus service been performing recently?

scene.promptZh: 一間青年中心原本每晚開放，近兩個月屢次臨時取消活動，出席率亦逐週下降。哪句最完整說明趨勢？

options.en: The programme begins to slide as cancellations become frequent.
options.zh: 活動經常取消後，計劃的運作開始走下坡。

options.en: The centre should send cancellation messages earlier.
options.zh: 中心應更早發出取消通知。

options.en: Attendance figures should be checked at the end of each month.
options.zh: 每月底應檢查出席率。

scene.explanationZh: 後兩句是合理改善或監察建議；金句直接描述服務開始變差。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句不恰當地把「開始下滑」誇大為全面崩潰？

options.en: Standards began to slide after several inspections were missed.
options.zh: 數次檢查未進行後，標準開始下滑。

options.en: Quality begins to slide, so every part of the service has already failed beyond repair.
options.zh: 品質開始下滑，所以服務的每個部分早已無法挽救。

options.en: Attendance began to slide slowly over the autumn term.
options.zh: 秋季學期期間出席率慢慢開始下降。

contrast.explanationZh: begins to slide 只表示惡化開始，不能推出所有部分已無法挽救。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「三個月的準時率都下降了，該怎樣向理事會說？」你想準確表述早期趨勢。哪句最合適？

options.en: Punctuality begins to slide when delays recur month after month.
options.zh: 延誤月復一月出現時，準時率便開始下滑。

options.en: We should include the monthly figures in our report.
options.zh: 我們應把每月數字納入報告。

options.en: The board may ask what caused the repeated delays.
options.zh: 理事會或會追問反覆延誤的原因。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句是合理報告安排；金句準確命名了早期惡化趨勢。

speaking.en: Attendance begins to slide when weekly cancellations become normal.
speaking.zh: 每週取消活動變成常態時，出席率便開始下滑。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，指出哪一項表現出現早期惡化。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：小型游泳池原本準時開門，但最近六週屢次延遲，投訴逐漸增多。用一至兩句英文向主管報告早期服務趨勢，不要說泳池已關閉。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說明準時率或服務質素如何開始下降，並提供連續六週的線索；避免說全面失敗。

examples.en: The pool’s punctuality begins to slide when opening delays recur for six weeks.
examples.zh: 泳池連續六週延遲開門，準時率便開始下滑。

examples.en: Service quality began to slide as repeated late openings led to more complaints.
examples.zh: 反覆延遲開門帶來更多投訴後，服務質素開始下滑。

takeaways.en: A few setbacks do not prove that an entire service has begun to slide.
takeaways.zh: 幾次挫折不足以證明整項服務已開始走下坡。

takeaways.en: Customer confidence began to slide after repeated missed deadlines.
takeaways.zh: 多次錯過限期後，顧客信心開始下滑。

brief.meaningEn: Arouse or evoke a wish for something; the wish may be new or previously latent.
brief.meaningZh: 引起或喚醒想要某物或某種體驗的心情；這種願望可以是新產生，也可以原本已有但未被察覺。
brief.grammar: Use stir desire with a message, experience or image as subject; a for-phrase can name the object wanted.
brief.register: Advertising, storytelling and cultural discussion of evoked interest.
brief.boundaryZh: 重點是喚起或撩動渴望，並不表示這一定是人生第一次有此願望。若明確知道原有願望被加強，amplify an existing desire 更能點明變化。
brief.misconceptionZh: 被廣告喚起渴望不等於已購買，也不保證想法會持續；stir 並不要求先證明願望完全不存在。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用 stir desire 表達渴望被喚起，並在有原有願望證據時判斷 amplify an existing desire 是否更精確。

sources.sentence: A clever advert stirs desire for new products.

listening.en: A museum visitor had never considered pottery classes. After seeing students shape clay in a short film, she wanted to try one herself. The film stirred desire for a first lesson.
listening.zh: 一名博物館訪客從沒想過上陶藝課。她看過學生在短片中塑造陶泥後，也想親身試一課；短片喚起了她的興趣。

options.en: It awakened a new wish to try pottery.
options.zh: 它喚起了她想嘗試陶藝的新念頭。

options.en: It confirmed that she had already booked a class.
options.zh: 它證實她早已預訂課程。

options.en: It made her purchase a pottery wheel immediately.
options.zh: 它使她立即購買陶輪。

options.en: It made her forget what pottery is.
options.zh: 它令她忘記陶藝是甚麼。

listening.explanationZh: 訪客原本沒想過上課，短片才喚起新願望；想試不等於已預訂或購買。

reply.promptZh: 這段旅行短片有甚麼作用？

options.en: It helps viewers picture the mountain route before they travel.
options.zh: 它讓觀眾在出發前更容易想像山區路線的情況。

options.en: It leaves some viewers curious enough to compare ticket prices.
options.zh: 它令部分觀眾感到好奇，因而去比較票價。

options.en: It stirs desire to explore the region among first-time viewers.
options.zh: 它在首次觀看的人心中喚起探索這個地區的渴望。

options.en: It makes some viewers feel better prepared for the mountain weather.
options.zh: 它讓部分觀眾覺得自己對山區天氣有更充分準備。

reply.explanationZh: 四句均可自然評述短片；金句直接使用本課表達描述首次被喚起的興趣。
reply.promptEn: What effect does the travel film have?

scene.promptZh: 一班學生本來沒興趣種植。看過鄰校的屋頂花園照片後，他們主動詢問如何開展。哪句最完整描述照片的作用？

options.en: The photos stirred desire to start a garden among the students.
options.zh: 照片喚起學生開辦花園的願望。

options.en: The photos showed how large the neighbouring roof was.
options.zh: 照片顯示鄰校天台有多大。

options.en: The students should check whether their school roof is safe.
options.zh: 學生應先檢查學校天台是否安全。

scene.explanationZh: 後兩句有關照片或下一步；金句點出學生原本沒有、現在才有的想法。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最明確顯示「原有願望被加強」，因此用 amplify an existing desire 更精確？

options.en: Someone who had never thought of learning chess sees a club poster and becomes curious.
options.zh: 從未想過學棋的人看見學會海報後產生興趣。

options.en: A traveller who has wanted to visit Kyoto for years sees another advert and wants to go even more.
options.zh: 一名多年想去京都的旅客看見另一則廣告後更想出發。

options.en: A child first sees a telescope demonstration and asks to try stargazing.
options.zh: 小孩首次看見望遠鏡示範後，要求嘗試觀星。

contrast.explanationZh: 旅客多年來已有赴京都的願望，廣告令這份原有願望更強；這是 amplify an existing desire 最明確的情況，但 stir 本身不只限於首次產生的願望。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這段音樂節預告會否讓未曾考慮過的人想去？」你想區分新興趣與購票行動。哪句最合適？

options.en: It may stir desire to attend, but wanting to go is not the same as buying a ticket.
options.zh: 它可能喚起參加的渴望，但想去不等於已買票。

options.en: The organiser should show the full performance schedule.
options.zh: 主辦者應展示完整演出時間表。

options.en: Viewers can compare transport options before deciding.
options.zh: 觀眾可在決定前比較交通安排。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句是合理安排；金句直接回答預告是否喚起願望，並避免把願望當成購買。

speaking.en: A glimpse of the rehearsal can stir desire to hear the whole concert.
speaking.zh: 排練片段可能喚起人們想聽完整音樂會的渴望。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，說明願望是如何被喚起的。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一名同學原本對天文沒有興趣，看過校園觀星活動短片後開始想借望遠鏡。用一至兩句英文說明短片的作用。
writing.selfCheckZh: 交代原本沒有興趣、現在產生想法；不要說他已借到望遠鏡。

examples.en: The short film stirred desire to try stargazing in a pupil who had never considered it before.
examples.zh: 短片在一名原本從未想過觀星的學生心中喚起嘗試的願望。

examples.en: Seeing the night sky in the video stirred desire to borrow a telescope, although the pupil has not booked one.
examples.zh: 影片中的夜空喚起了借用望遠鏡的渴望，但該學生尚未預約。

takeaways.en: A vivid story can stir desire to explore a subject someone had ignored.
takeaways.zh: 生動故事可以喚起人們探索原本忽略的課題的渴望。

takeaways.en: Stirring desire does not mean a viewer has already decided to buy.
takeaways.zh: 喚起渴望不表示觀眾已決定購買。

brief.meaningEn: Intensify a wish that was already present.
brief.meaningZh: 把原本已存在的願望進一步加強。
brief.grammar: Use amplify an existing desire when there is clear evidence of a prior wish; the amplifier strengthens rather than creates it.
brief.register: Advertising, persuasion and decision-making analysis where prior interest is documented.
brief.boundaryZh: 必須先有原有願望，後有令它更強的刺激；首次出現的興趣沒有可被 amplify 的原有願望，但 stir desire 並不限於第一次。
brief.misconceptionZh: 願望加強不保證購買或行動，也不表示原有願望由廣告創造。
brief.outcomeZh: 能找出原有願望的證據與後來加強它的因素。

sources.sentence: The campaign succeeded by amplifying an existing desire.

listening.en: Lena had planned to buy a used bicycle for months. A repair shop then posted a video showing how easily old bikes can be restored. The video amplified an existing desire rather than giving her a new one.
listening.zh: 莉娜數月來一直計劃買二手單車。後來維修店發放影片，展示舊單車很容易修復；影片加強了她原有的願望，並非創造一個新願望。

options.en: It strengthened a wish Lena already had.
options.zh: 它加強了莉娜原本已有的願望。

options.en: It made Lena think about bicycles for the first time.
options.zh: 它令莉娜第一次想起單車。

options.en: It proved she had already purchased a bicycle.
options.zh: 它證明她已買了單車。

options.en: It removed her interest in repairing bicycles.
options.zh: 它消除了她對修復單車的興趣。

listening.explanationZh: 莉娜原本已計劃購買；影片只是令既有願望更強。

reply.promptZh: 這項宣傳對已打算參加的人有甚麼作用？

options.en: It reminds them of the event date.
options.zh: 它提醒他們活動日期。

options.en: It may help them compare the available sessions.
options.zh: 它或可幫他們比較可選時段。

options.en: It amplifies an existing desire to take part by showing the new activities.
options.zh: 它展示新活動，進一步加強他們原本想參加的願望。

options.en: It helps them find out where they can collect their tickets.
options.zh: 它幫助他們了解可以在哪裏領取門票。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可自然描述宣傳；金句點明原有意願被進一步加強。
reply.promptEn: How does the promotion affect people who already plan to attend?

scene.promptZh: 一名學生早就想加入辯論隊，新公布的海外交流機會令她更積極查詢報名。哪句最完整描述新消息的效果？

options.en: The exchange opportunity amplified an existing desire to join the team.
options.zh: 交流機會加強了她原本想加入團隊的願望。

options.en: The student checked the application deadline.
options.zh: 學生查看了報名截止日期。

options.en: The team should explain the travel costs before enrolment.
options.zh: 團隊應在報名之前說明旅費。

scene.explanationZh: 學生加入的願望早已存在；交流機會令它更強。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況缺少「原本已有願望」這一必要條件？

options.en: A runner already wants new shoes; a comparison video makes her keener to buy.
options.zh: 跑者原本想買新鞋；比較影片令她更想購買。

options.en: A viewer has never considered gardening; one poster creates that interest for the first time.
options.zh: 觀眾從未想過種植；一張海報首次令他產生興趣。

options.en: A family has long wanted a rail trip; a discount makes the plan more appealing.
options.zh: 家庭一直想坐火車旅行；折扣令計劃更吸引。

contrast.explanationZh: 從未想過、首次產生興趣，並沒有可被加強的原有願望。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「宣傳片是不是創造了家長想參加這個營隊的想法？」你知道家長先前已在候補名單上。哪句最合適？

options.en: It amplified an existing desire; the parents had already joined the waiting list.
options.zh: 它加強了原有願望；家長早已加入候補名單。

options.en: The waiting list shows that places may be limited.
options.zh: 候補名單顯示名額可能有限。

options.en: We should ask what part of the film parents found most useful.
options.zh: 我們應詢問家長覺得影片哪部分最有用。

dialogue.explanationZh: 另兩句合理，但金句以候補名單證明願望在宣傳片前已存在。

speaking.en: The new workshop details amplified an existing desire among volunteers who had already signed up.
speaking.zh: 已報名的義工看到工作坊新詳情後，原有的參加願望進一步加強。
speaking.promptZh: 聽示範後，找出證明原有願望存在的線索。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一個家庭幾個月來都想參加單車旅行，新的路線影片令他們更期待，但還未付款。用一至兩句英文說明影片作用。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出原本已有的意願和後來加強的因素；不要說已付款或新願望首次出現。

examples.en: The route video amplified an existing desire for a cycling trip that the family had discussed for months.
examples.zh: 路線影片加強了這家人討論了數月的單車旅行願望。

examples.en: Showing the quieter roads amplified an existing desire to travel by bike, although the family has not paid yet.
examples.zh: 影片展示較寧靜的道路，令這家人原本想騎單車旅行的願望更強，但他們尚未付款。

takeaways.en: A reminder can amplify an existing desire without creating a new need.
takeaways.zh: 提醒可以加強原有願望，卻不會創造新需要。

takeaways.en: The exhibition preview amplified an existing desire to visit among people who already held tickets.
takeaways.zh: 展覽預告讓已持票人士原本想參觀的願望更強。

lessons.titleZh: 以特定需要為設計考量

brief.meaningEn: Designed while deliberately considering a particular user, purpose or constraint.
brief.meaningZh: 設計時特別考慮某類使用者、用途或條件。
brief.grammar: Use be built with X in mind; X names a priority, not an automatic sacrifice of every other quality.
brief.register: Product and service design, said by a designer, user or reviewer.
brief.boundaryZh: 需有證據顯示該需要影響設計；不必同時犧牲清晰度。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不能只見到成品速度快，就斷言設計時必然忽略其他需要。
brief.outcomeZh: 能說明設計重點，並分清重點與附帶取捨。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 181, row 7; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The app was built with speed in mind rather than clarity.
sources.expression: built with speed in mind rather than clarity

listening.promptZh: 為何中心放大告示上的路線指示？

options.en: To make the directions easier for first-time visitors to follow.
options.zh: 為了讓首次到訪者更容易看懂路線指示。

options.en: To reduce how often staff need to answer routine route questions.
options.zh: 為了減少職員回答一般路線問題的次數。

options.en: To make the sign match the centre’s other notices.
options.zh: 為了讓告示與中心其他告示的風格一致。

options.en: To fit more destinations onto one sign.
options.zh: 為了在同一塊告示上放進更多目的地。

listening.explanationZh: 中心讓新訪客試看並放大指示，說明清晰度是設計考量；沒有證據指所有訪客能力相同。
listening.en: The community centre tested its new wayfinding sign with first-time visitors and enlarged the route text. It was built with clarity in mind.
listening.zh: 社區中心請首次到訪者試看新路線告示，並放大路線文字；告示設計特別重視清晰易懂。

reply.promptZh: （圖書館設計新的預約頁面時，想達到甚麼目的？）

options.en: It wanted readers to find available rooms quickly.
options.zh: 它希望讀者能迅速找到有空的房間。

options.en: It wanted frequent visitors to finish bookings with fewer clicks.
options.zh: 它希望常客能以較少步驟完成預約。

options.en: The page was built with older users in mind, so the text is easier to read.
options.zh: 頁面設計時顧及年長使用者，因此文字較易閱讀。

options.en: It put the booking steps in a clearer order.
options.zh: 它把預約步驟排得更清楚。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可以回答設計目標；金句以本課句型指出被考慮的使用者。
reply.promptEn: What was the library trying to achieve with its new booking page?

scene.promptZh: 一所學校請低年級學生試用新的圖書搜尋頁，並依他們的反應放大圖示。哪句最能概括設計方向？

options.en: The page was built with younger children in mind.
options.zh: 頁面設計時特別考慮年幼學生。

options.en: The school designed the page mainly for older pupils who read quickly.
options.zh: 學校主要為閱讀速度快的高年級學生設計這個頁面。

options.en: The school wanted searches to take fewer steps for pupils of every age.
options.zh: 學校希望各年齡層學生都能以較少步驟完成搜尋。

scene.explanationZh: 試用者是低年級學生，修改亦回應他們的反應；其他說法轉而強調年長學生或所有年齡層的搜尋速度，不能準確概括此設計重點。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不能證明產品是 built with accessibility in mind？

options.en: The team tests the form with screen-reader users and revises its labels.
options.zh: 設計團隊與使用螢幕閱讀器的人測試表格，然後修改標籤。

options.en: The team calls the site accessible but never checks keyboard access or text alternatives.
options.zh: 團隊只把網站稱為「無障礙」，卻沒有檢查鍵盤操作或文字替代。

options.en: Developers make every button usable by keyboard after user feedback.
options.zh: 開發者根據使用者回報，讓所有按鈕都能用鍵盤操作。

contrast.explanationZh: 口號不能代替設計或測試證據；實際修訂才可支持「顧及無障礙」的說法。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「這個新候車亭為何有較大的路線字體？」你知道團隊訪問過視力較弱的乘客。你怎樣回答最完整？

options.en: It was built with low-vision passengers in mind after the team heard their feedback.
options.zh: 團隊聽取視力較弱乘客的意見後，設計候車亭時特別顧及他們。

options.en: The team asked passengers which signs were difficult to read.
options.zh: 團隊詢問乘客哪些指示牌難以閱讀。

options.en: The larger type should make the route names easier to see.
options.zh: 較大的字體應能讓路線名稱更易看見。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句同時指出設計對象和根據回饋作出的改動；另外兩句只說其中一方面。

speaking.en: The new timetable was built with busy commuters in mind, so the next bus time is easy to find.
speaking.zh: 新時間表的設計顧及忙碌的通勤者，因此下一班車的時間容易找到。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽完整示範，再說明時間表為誰而設。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區泳池要重印入場須知。家長反映舊告示文字太密，小孩也看不懂。新版用簡短句子和清楚圖示。用一至兩句英文說明設計考量及具體改動。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出設計對象或目的，以及新告示的實際改動；不要斷言舊告示沒有任何用途。

examples.en: The new pool notice was built with families in mind: it uses short sentences and clear pictures.
examples.zh: 新的泳池告示在設計時顧及家庭使用者，採用簡短句子和清楚的圖示。

examples.en: After parents said the old notice was hard to read, the centre built the replacement with children in mind and added simple icons.
examples.zh: 家長反映舊告示難以閱讀後，中心設計新告示時顧及兒童，並加入簡單圖示。

takeaways.en: The guide was built with first-time visitors in mind, so each step is clearly numbered.
takeaways.zh: 這份指南的設計顧及首次到訪者，因此每個步驟都有清楚編號。

takeaways.en: A product can be built with speed in mind and still be easy to understand.
takeaways.zh: 產品可以在設計時重視速度，同時仍然易於理解。

lessons.titleZh: 不靠共同語言也能互相理解

brief.meaningEn: A common way of understanding or connecting through an activity, even when people do not share spoken words.
brief.meaningZh: 透過共同活動建立理解與連繫，即使彼此不說同一種語言。
brief.grammar: Use a shared language figuratively for a common activity or practice; do not claim the people literally speak one language.
brief.register: Cross-cultural teamwork, arts or sport; a participant describes how people connect.
brief.boundaryZh: 共同活動能提供互相理解的起點，卻不保證所有分歧都消失。
brief.misconceptionZh: 這裡的 language 是比喻，不是指大家突然學會同一種口語。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出共同活動如何成為跨語言的交流途徑。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 185, row 2; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Football creates a shared language that does not depend entirely on words.
sources.expression: shared language that does not depend entirely on words

listening.promptZh: 象棋在這裏如何幫助兩位學生？

options.en: It lets them connect through the rules and moves despite a language gap.
options.zh: 即使有語言隔閡，他們仍能透過規則和棋步交流。

options.en: It gave them a familiar activity to discuss after the game.
options.zh: 它給了他們一項賽後可以談論的共同活動。

options.en: It helped them practise a few chess terms in one language.
options.zh: 它幫助他們練習某一種語言中的少量象棋術語。

options.en: It meant they understood each other’s ideas equally well outside the game.
options.zh: 它表示他們在遊戲以外也同樣能理解彼此的想法。

listening.explanationZh: 共同下棋讓兩人透過規則和棋步交流；講者沒有說他們學會術語，或在遊戲以外也同樣理解彼此。
listening.en: Two exchange students could not explain every chess move in the same language, but they understood each other through the game. Chess gave them a shared language.
listening.zh: 兩位交流生無法用同一種語言解釋每步棋，卻能透過對弈互相理解；象棋成了他們共同的交流方式。

reply.promptZh: （來訪學生與本地學生在藝術工作坊中如何建立連繫？）

options.en: They took turns showing each other how to mix the colours.
options.zh: 他們輪流示範如何調配顏色。

options.en: They used drawing as a shared language when words were difficult.
options.zh: 言語溝通有困難時，他們以繪畫作為共同的交流方式。

options.en: They compared their sketches and asked simple questions.
options.zh: 他們比較彼此的素描，並提出簡單問題。

options.en: They completed one picture together by sharing the brushes.
options.zh: 他們輪流用畫筆，合力完成一幅畫。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述建立連繫的方法；金句用比喻概括繪畫如何跨越口語障礙。
reply.promptEn: How did the visiting students and local students connect during the art workshop?

scene.promptZh: 兩隊來自不同地區的學生沒有共通語言，卻透過共同排練舞蹈理解彼此的節奏。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The dance became a shared language for the two groups.
options.zh: 舞蹈成了兩組學生共同的交流方式。

options.en: The groups became familiar with the same sequence of dance steps.
options.zh: 兩組學生逐漸熟悉相同的舞步次序。

options.en: The groups followed the instructor’s cues during rehearsal.
options.zh: 兩組學生在排練時跟隨導師的提示。

scene.explanationZh: 共同排練讓兩組學生跨越語言差異來交流；熟悉舞步或跟隨導師提示，只描述了排練的一部分。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合把活動稱為 a shared language？

options.en: The students use a common rhythm to coordinate without many words.
options.zh: 學生不用說太多話，也能依共同節奏協調。

options.en: The groups never meet or practise together and cannot follow each other’s signals.
options.zh: 兩組從未見面或一起練習，也讀不懂彼此的訊號。

options.en: Players from two places learn to communicate through the same game rules.
options.zh: 來自兩地的玩家學會透過相同遊戲規則交流。

contrast.explanationZh: 沒有共同活動或可辨識的訊號，便缺乏支撐這個比喻的共同理解。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我們不太懂對方的口語，要怎樣一起完成壁畫？」你知道大家都能先畫草圖並互相指示。哪句最合適？

options.en: Our sketches can become a shared language while we plan the mural together.
options.zh: 一起規劃壁畫時，草圖可以成為我們共同的交流方式。

options.en: We can each draw a small draft and show it to the group.
options.zh: 我們可各自畫一張小草圖，展示給小組看。

options.en: Let us agree on the main shapes before we paint the wall.
options.zh: 在牆上作畫前，我們先商定主要形狀吧。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句直接回答跨語言合作的疑問，另外兩句提供有用步驟，但沒有概括共同理解。

speaking.en: In the cooking workshop, preparing the same dish gave the visitors a shared language.
speaking.zh: 在烹飪工作坊中，一起準備同一道菜讓訪客有了共同的交流方式。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明共同活動如何促進理解。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：來自三所學校的學生一起製作木偶劇。有些人不熟悉彼此的口語，但可透過排練動作和表情協調。用一至兩句英文說明木偶劇如何幫助他們合作，並保留可能仍需討論的空間。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出共同活動帶來的理解，同時不要聲稱所有語言障礙已完全消失。

examples.en: The puppet play gave the students a shared language through movement and expression, even when some words needed explaining.
examples.zh: 木偶劇讓學生透過動作和表情建立共同的交流方式，雖然某些詞語仍需解釋。

examples.en: During rehearsals, gestures became a shared language for the three schools, but the students still checked important details aloud.
examples.zh: 排練期間，手勢成了三所學校學生共同的交流方式，但他們仍會口頭確認重要細節。

takeaways.en: A game can offer a shared language before its players know many of the same words.
takeaways.zh: 玩家尚未掌握許多相同詞語時，遊戲也能提供共同的交流方式。

takeaways.en: For the visiting group, music became a shared language, not proof that every misunderstanding had ended.
takeaways.zh: 對訪客團體來說，音樂成了共同的交流方式，但不代表所有誤會都已消失。

brief.meaningEn: The social or cultural gap between people becomes smaller as they interact.
brief.meaningZh: 人們交流之後，社交或文化上的隔閡縮小。
brief.grammar: Use the distance between them shrinks or its natural past/perfect forms after identifying two people or groups; distance is figurative.
brief.register: Students, neighbours or visiting groups discussing growing familiarity.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有互動或理解增加的線索；不表示從此毫無分歧。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是量度兩人站立位置，也不是只因坐近了便能推斷關係變好。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體互動解釋隔閡如何縮小，同時不誇大結果。

sources.sentence: After playing together, the distance between them often shrinks.

listening.promptZh: 合唱團員之間有甚麼改變？

options.en: They became more familiar through shared practice.
options.zh: 他們透過共同練習，逐漸熟悉彼此。

options.en: They became more confident performing each other’s songs.
options.zh: 他們演唱對方的歌曲時變得更有信心。

options.en: They found it easier to plan rehearsals around a shared song list.
options.zh: 有了共同曲目表後，他們更容易安排排練。

options.en: They settled on a programme for their next concert.
options.zh: 他們決定了下次音樂會的曲目。

listening.explanationZh: 講者指出一起交換歌曲和排練後，兩組成員的隔閡縮小；其他選項只推測技能或排練安排。
listening.en: The local and visiting choir members began by rehearsing separately. After they exchanged songs and practised together, the distance between them shrank.
listening.zh: 本地與來訪合唱團員起初分開排練；互相分享歌曲並一同練習後，彼此的隔閡縮小了。

reply.promptZh: （兩個社區小組一起打理花園後，發生了甚麼事？）

options.en: They learned one another’s names and began to talk more often.
options.zh: 他們記住彼此的名字，開始更常交談。

options.en: The distance between them shrank as they planned the planting together.
options.zh: 一起規劃種植工作時，他們之間的隔閡縮小了。

options.en: They agreed on a timetable for watering the plants.
options.zh: 他們商定了澆水時間表。

options.en: They found a way to share the tools fairly.
options.zh: 他們找到公平共用工具的方法。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都描述合作後的結果；金句用本課比喻概括關係上的改變。
reply.promptEn: What happened after the two neighbourhood groups worked together on the garden?

scene.promptZh: 兩所學校的辯論隊起初互有戒心；共同練習兩週後，隊員開始主動交換意見。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The distance between them shrank through their joint practice.
options.zh: 一起練習讓他們之間的隔閡縮小了。

options.en: The teams found a debate format that both could follow.
options.zh: 兩隊找到雙方都能依循的辯論形式。

options.en: Their arguments became more similar after the joint practice.
options.zh: 一起練習後，兩隊的論點變得較相似。

scene.explanationZh: 主動交換意見顯示彼此關係拉近；形式或論點的改變只涉及辯論安排與內容。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不支持「the distance between them shrank」這種說法？

options.en: The groups begin sharing ideas after several joint sessions.
options.zh: 幾次共同活動後，兩組開始交換意見。

options.en: They stand one metre closer for a photograph but never interact.
options.zh: 他們拍照時站近了一米，卻完全沒有交流。

options.en: Neighbours who once avoided each other begin organising a meal together.
options.zh: 本來互相迴避的鄰居開始一起籌辦聚餐。

contrast.explanationZh: 只是站得較近，卻沒有關係或理解上的改變，不足以支持這個比喻。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「兩個班之前很生疏，現在卻一起設計展板。」你怎樣描述這段變化最貼切？

options.en: The distance between them shrank as they worked on the display.
options.zh: 他們一起製作展板時，彼此的隔閡縮小了。

options.en: They had more chances to discuss their designs.
options.zh: 他們有更多機會討論設計。

options.en: The display gave the classes a shared task.
options.zh: 展板讓兩個班有了共同任務。

dialogue.explanationZh: 共同製作展板提供關係改善的線索；金句把線索連到隔閡縮小。

speaking.en: After the teams cooked together twice, the distance between them shrank.
speaking.zh: 兩隊一起煮食兩次後，彼此的隔閡縮小了。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說出關係如何改變。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：新舊義工在社區農墟起初很少交談。經過幾次共同佈置攤位，他們開始互相請教和分享做法。用一至兩句英文描述關係變化及其原因。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出共同做事及交流增加，不要寫成他們從此毫無分歧。

examples.en: The distance between them shrank after several shared market shifts, when the volunteers began asking one another for advice.
examples.zh: 幾次一起在農墟當值後，義工開始互相請教，彼此的隔閡縮小了。

examples.en: By setting up stalls together and exchanging tips, the new and experienced volunteers found that the distance between them was shrinking.
examples.zh: 新舊義工一起佈置攤位並交換心得，發現彼此的隔閡正逐漸縮小。

glossary.zh: 一起在農墟當值的班次

takeaways.en: The distance between them shrank when the neighbours began planning together.
takeaways.zh: 鄰居開始一起規劃後，彼此的隔閡縮小了。

takeaways.en: The distance between them is shrinking, though they still disagree about some details.
takeaways.zh: 彼此的隔閡正在縮小，雖然他們對某些細節仍有分歧。

brief.meaningEn: An activity that exercises thinking, like physical exercise works the body.
brief.meaningZh: 把需要思考的活動比作鍛鍊身體，表示它讓人動腦筋。
brief.grammar: Use a workout for the brain of a specific thinking task; the metaphor does not prove a lasting rise in intelligence.
brief.register: Informal discussion of puzzles, strategy games or learning tasks.
brief.boundaryZh: 須涉及思考或解題；不等於有科學證據證明智力必然提高。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是指真的在健身房鍛鍊大腦，也不是只要玩一次便會變聰明。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出活動中具體的思考工作，避免誇大成效。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 190, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A puzzle is a little workout for the brain.
sources.expression: a little workout for the brain

listening.promptZh: 美娜為何這樣形容邏輯題？

options.en: It made her compare possibilities and reason through a problem.
options.zh: 它讓她比較不同可能性，逐步思考問題。

options.en: It helped her memorise the puzzle’s wording for a later quiz.
options.zh: 它幫助她記住題目字眼，以便之後的小測使用。

options.en: It gave her practice in explaining a solution to other people.
options.zh: 它讓她練習向其他人解釋解法。

options.en: It let her practise a familiar solving method she already knew.
options.zh: 它讓她練習自己早已熟悉的解題方法。

listening.explanationZh: 她嘗試並比較幾個答案，因此這是推理練習；講者沒有提到之後的小測、向別人解釋解法，或既有解題方法。
listening.en: Mina tried a logic puzzle that made her test several possible answers before finding one that worked. She called it a workout for the brain.
listening.zh: 美娜做了一道邏輯題，反覆檢驗幾種可能答案才找到可行的一個；她說這是讓腦筋動一動的練習。

reply.promptZh: （老師為甚麼給全班一道簡短的規律題？）

options.en: She wanted the class to compare several possible patterns.
options.zh: 她希望全班比較幾種可能的規律。

options.en: She wanted students to explain how they reached an answer.
options.zh: 她希望學生解釋如何得出答案。

options.en: It was a little workout for the brain before the main lesson.
options.zh: 正式課堂前，那是一道讓腦筋動一動的小練習。

options.en: It gave the class a brief task to solve together.
options.zh: 它讓全班一起解決一項簡短任務。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可說明老師安排題目的目的；金句用本課比喻概括思考練習。
reply.promptEn: Why did the teacher give the class a short pattern puzzle?

scene.promptZh: 讀書會讓成員根據短文線索推測失物的位置，再解釋排除其他地點的原因。哪句最貼切？

options.en: Using the clues to locate the missing item gave the members a workout for the brain.
options.zh: 根據線索推斷失物在哪裏，讓成員好好動了一番腦筋。

options.en: The activity mainly checked how much of the passage members could recall.
options.zh: 活動主要測試成員記得短文多少內容。

options.en: The club was comparing members’ reading speeds.
options.zh: 讀書會正在比較成員的閱讀速度。

scene.explanationZh: 比較不同線索並解釋排除理由，正是動腦分析；記憶短文或比較閱讀速度並非重點。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合稱為 a workout for the brain？

options.en: A child compares clues and explains a solution.
options.zh: 孩子比較線索並解釋解法。

options.en: A player chooses moves by weighing several risks.
options.zh: 玩家衡量幾種風險後選擇走法。

options.en: Someone copies a printed answer without reading the question.
options.zh: 有人連題目也沒看，就照抄印好的答案。

contrast.explanationZh: 不看題目直接抄答案，沒有顯示需要實際思考。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「這道題只有五分鐘，應該沒有甚麼用吧？」你知道它要比較三條線索。哪句最合適？

options.en: Even a short puzzle can be a workout for the brain if it asks us to compare clues.
options.zh: 即使題目很短，只要要比較線索，也能讓腦筋動一動。

options.en: We can try it and explain why we reject two of the clues.
options.zh: 我們可以試做，並解釋為何排除其中兩條線索。

options.en: Its value depends on what we actually have to think through.
options.zh: 它的價值取決於我們實際要思考甚麼。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句把短題目與具體推理連起來；另外兩句也合理，但沒有使用本課比喻。

speaking.en: Comparing the clues was a workout for the brain, even though the puzzle was short.
speaking.zh: 比較線索讓腦筋動了一動，雖然這道題很短。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明活動如何讓人思考。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校午休設計了一個桌上解謎遊戲。學生要比較地圖、時間表和三張便條，找出圖書館藏書的位置。用一至兩句英文說明為何它是思考練習，避免誇大長期效果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出學生需要比較哪些線索；不要聲稱玩一次就能永久提升智力。

examples.en: The lunchtime puzzle is a workout for the brain because students compare a map, a timetable and three notes before choosing an answer.
examples.zh: 這道午休解謎題讓腦筋動一動，因為學生要比較地圖、時間表和三張便條才選出答案。

examples.en: Checking the different clues makes the game a workout for the brain, but one round does not prove a lasting change in anyone’s ability.
examples.zh: 檢查不同線索讓這遊戲成為思考練習，但玩一回並不能證明任何人的能力會長期改變。

takeaways.en: A new strategy question can be a workout for the brain when it asks us to weigh alternatives.
takeaways.zh: 新的策略題若要求我們衡量不同方案，就能讓腦筋動一動。

takeaways.en: Before the exam, a brief reasoning game gave the class a workout for the brain.
takeaways.zh: 考試前，簡短的推理遊戲讓全班動了動腦筋。

brief.meaningEn: The route towards a demanding goal has fewer places or opportunities at a later stage.
brief.meaningZh: 朝高要求目標前進時，後期可用的名額或機會變少。
brief.grammar: Use the road narrows for a specified pathway with increasing selection pressure; sharply adds degree.
brief.register: Education, arts or sport selection discussed by a coach, adviser or applicant.
brief.boundaryZh: 要有後段名額或機會收窄的證據；不等於某個人必定失敗。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是道路施工變窄，也不是只要遇到困難便必然可用。
brief.outcomeZh: 能解釋選拔後期機會縮小，而不替個別申請者預言結果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 195, row 11; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: At the professional level, the road narrows sharply.

listening.promptZh: 講者說 the road narrows sharply，意思是甚麼？

options.en: Later selection has far fewer available places.
options.zh: 後期選拔可用的名額少得多。

options.en: The orchestra is changing how it judges the remaining players.
options.zh: 樂團正在改變評審餘下樂手的方式。

options.en: The youth programme as a whole is accepting fewer players.
options.zh: 整個青年培訓計劃都在減少取錄樂手。

options.en: The finalists have less time to prepare their pieces.
options.zh: 決賽樂手準備樂曲的時間減少了。

listening.explanationZh: 比喻指最終合奏團只有六個名額；並非整個青年計劃收生縮減，也沒有提及評審或準備時間改變。
listening.en: The regional orchestra welcomes many young players, but only six places are available in its final ensemble. At that stage, the road narrows sharply.
listening.zh: 地區樂團接納很多年輕樂手，但最終合奏團只有六個名額；到那一階段，可走的路就明顯變窄。

reply.promptZh: （申請者進入設計比賽最後階段後，有甚麼變化？）

options.en: Only a small number of project places remain.
options.zh: 只餘少量項目名額。

options.en: The judges compare the remaining proposals more closely.
options.zh: 評審更仔細比較餘下提案。

options.en: The road narrows when the field is reduced to a few finalists.
options.zh: 參賽者減至少數決賽者時，前進的道路就變窄了。

options.en: Finalists must explain their designs in more detail.
options.zh: 決賽者須更詳細解釋自己的設計。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可描述決賽階段；金句用比喻概括名額收窄。
reply.promptEn: What changes after applicants reach the final design competition?

scene.promptZh: 學生合唱團有四十人參加初選，但巡演只設五個獨唱名額。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The road narrows sharply before the soloist places are awarded.
options.zh: 在分配獨唱名額前，可走的路明顯變窄。

options.en: The choir will use a more detailed second audition for soloists.
options.zh: 合唱團將為獨唱者舉行更仔細的第二輪遴選。

options.en: Experience is now the main factor in choosing the soloists.
options.zh: 經驗現在是挑選獨唱者的主要因素。

scene.explanationZh: 四十人競逐五個名額，後期獲選機會較少；情境沒有說遴選方式或主要評審準則改變。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合用 the road narrows 形容？

options.en: A school offers ten final places after an open first round.
options.zh: 學校在公開首輪後只提供十個最終名額。

options.en: The number of available roles falls at the professional stage.
options.zh: 到專業階段，可用的角色數目減少。

options.en: A street loses a traffic lane during repairs, but no selection is involved.
options.zh: 街道維修時少了一條行車線，卻沒有任何選拔。

contrast.explanationZh: 這裏教的是機會變少的比喻；純粹道路施工屬字面情況。

dialogue.promptZh: 同學說：「初選開放給所有人，為何最後只有幾人能演出？」你知道舞台角色只有四個。哪句最完整？

options.en: The road narrows because the final production has only four stage roles.
options.zh: 最終演出只有四個舞台角色，所以可走的路變窄了。

options.en: There are fewer roles than people in the first round.
options.zh: 角色數目比首輪參加者少。

options.en: The final decision will depend on the auditions.
options.zh: 最後決定取決於遴選表現。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句指出後期名額限制；它沒有斷言任何特定同學必定落選。

speaking.en: Many people enter the open auditions, but the road narrows when only three parts remain.
speaking.zh: 很多人參加公開遴選，但只剩三個角色時，可走的路就變窄了。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明名額如何改變。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：校際短片比賽首輪收下三十部作品，決賽只邀請四組進行現場展示。用一至兩句英文描述進入決賽的機會如何改變，並避免預言某組的結果。
writing.selfCheckZh: 指出首輪與決賽的名額差異；不要說任何一組一定會落選。

examples.en: The road narrows sharply after the first round, as only four teams can present their films live.
examples.zh: 首輪後可走的路明顯變窄，因為只有四隊可以現場展示短片。

examples.en: Although thirty films entered, the road narrows at the final stage with just four presentation places.

takeaways.en: The road narrows when the number of available places falls in the final round.

takeaways.en: The road narrows sharply for applicants, but the result for any one person is still open.
takeaways.zh: 申請者面對的道路明顯變窄，但任何個人的結果仍未確定。

lessons.titleZh: 潛質可能無法充分發展

brief.meaningEn: Early potential might not fully develop if conditions or support are lacking.
brief.meaningZh: 早期展現的潛質若缺乏適當條件，可能無法充分發展。
brief.grammar: Promise means potential here; may or might never fully bloom keeps the outcome uncertain.
brief.register: Teachers, mentors or organisers discussing opportunities for a learner or artist.
brief.boundaryZh: 必須保留可能性，而非斷言某人必定無法發展。
brief.misconceptionZh: promise 在此不是承諾；bloom 是成長比喻，不是花朵開放。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出潛質與發展條件，並正確保留不確定性。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 195, row 12; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: Without support, that early promise may never fully bloom.

listening.promptZh: 講者擔心這位小提琴手甚麼？

options.en: Her potential might not develop fully without further opportunities.
options.zh: 若沒有更多機會，她的潛質可能無法充分發展。

options.en: She may need a different teacher before she can continue practising.
options.zh: 她可能要另找老師才能繼續練習。

options.en: Her ability is likely to stay at exactly the same level until the old programme returns.
options.zh: 在原有課程恢復前，她的能力大概會維持在完全相同的水平。

options.en: She is probably ready to perform professionally without more guidance.
options.zh: 即使沒有進一步指導，她大概已可作專業演出。

listening.explanationZh: 講者擔心課程提早結束會妨礙她發揮潛質，而非確定能力不再變化或已足以作專業演出。
listening.en: A young violinist showed skill, but the local programme ended before she could practise with a teacher. Her promise may never fully bloom if she cannot find another chance to train.
listening.zh: 一位年輕小提琴手展現了能力，但本地課程在她能跟老師練習前便結束；若找不到新的訓練機會，她的潛質可能無法充分發展。

reply.promptZh: （教練為甚麼希望年輕跑手有較長的訓練課程？）

options.en: They need more time to build on their early ability.
options.zh: 他們需要更多時間發展早期展現的能力。

options.en: The current course ends before many can explore their strengths.
options.zh: 目前課程在很多人有機會發掘長處前便結束。

options.en: If the training stops here, their promise may never fully bloom.
options.zh: 若訓練就此停止，他們的潛質可能無法充分發展。

options.en: The coach wants them to practise under regular guidance.
options.zh: 教練希望他們在定期指導下練習。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能解釋教練的想法；金句用本課比喻並保留「可能」的語氣。
reply.promptEn: Why does the coach want a longer training programme for the young runners?

scene.promptZh: 一位學生擅長寫劇本，但學校戲劇組暫停，她也找不到其他演出或指導機會。哪句最準確表達憂慮？

options.en: Her promise may never fully bloom now that the drama group has closed and she has nowhere to test her scripts.
options.zh: 戲劇組停辦後，她沒有地方試演劇本，潛質可能無法充分發展。

options.en: She may have to develop her scripts independently until the drama group returns.
options.zh: 在戲劇組恢復前，她可能要自行改進劇本。

options.en: She will probably improve at the same pace without rehearsal or feedback.
options.zh: 即使沒有排練或回饋，她的進步速度大概也會一樣。

scene.explanationZh: 停辦戲劇組和缺少試演、指導機會，令潛質能否充分發展存疑；不能斷言她的能力會原地踏步。

contrast.promptZh: 哪句最不符合 promise may never fully bloom 的原意？

options.en: A promising learner might need more opportunities to practise.
options.zh: 有潛質的學生可能需要更多練習機會。

options.en: Limited support could prevent ability from developing fully.
options.zh: 支援不足可能阻礙能力充分發展。

options.en: The learner is certain to fail, no matter what support becomes available.
options.zh: 不管日後有甚麼支援，這名學生都一定會失敗。

contrast.explanationZh: 原句的 may 表示不確定，不能改寫成無論條件如何都必然失敗。

dialogue.promptZh: 同事說：「她展現了很強的繪畫能力，但課室下月就關了。」你想建議尋找其他練習機會。哪句最合適？

options.en: Her promise may never fully bloom if she loses every place to practise; let us look for another studio.
options.zh: 若她失去所有練習場所，潛質可能無法充分發展；我們一起找另一間畫室吧。

options.en: We could ask another studio whether she may join its weekly sessions.
options.zh: 我們可問另一間畫室，她能否參加每週課堂。

options.en: Let us find out what support she would actually like.
options.zh: 我們先了解她實際希望得到甚麼支援。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句保留不確定性，並提出具體可行的下一步；另兩句也是合適建議。

speaking.en: Her promise may never fully bloom if the workshop closes before she can build her skills.
speaking.zh: 如果工作坊在她能進一步磨練技藝前結束，她的潛質可能無法充分發展。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明潛質和所需的條件。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：一位初中生在攝影社展現眼光，但社團停辦。附近文化中心或有課程，教師準備幫他查詢。用一至兩句英文表達對潛質的擔心及可能的下一步，不要把結果說死。
writing.selfCheckZh: 保留「可能」的語氣，並指出可查詢的後續機會；不要預言他必定失敗。

examples.en: His promise may never fully bloom if the cancelled club was his only place to practise; the teacher is looking for a different workshop.
examples.zh: 若停辦的社團是他唯一的練習機會，他的潛質可能無法充分發展；老師正尋找其他工作坊。

examples.en: The teacher is asking about an arts-centre course because the student’s promise may never fully bloom if he stops creating new work.
examples.zh: 老師正查詢藝術中心的課程，因為若學生停止創作新作品，他的潛質可能無法充分發展。

takeaways.en: The young inventor’s promise may never fully bloom if she cannot test her designs.
takeaways.zh: 若無法測試設計，這位年輕發明家的潛質可能無法充分發展。

takeaways.en: His promise may never fully bloom while he is shut out of performances, though another chance could change that.
takeaways.zh: 如果他一直沒有演出機會，潛質可能無法充分發展；不過，新機會仍可能改變結果。

brief.meaningEn: Search actively and persistently for something needed or hard to find.
brief.meaningZh: 為了找到所需或不易找到的東西而積極搜尋。
brief.grammar: Hunt for takes an object such as a repair shop or missing receipt; it is figurative here, with no animal chase.
brief.register: Everyday problem solving: a customer, parent or organiser describing a search.
brief.boundaryZh: 表示努力尋找，不保證最後找到了。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是打獵，也不是只等別人把東西送來。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體搜尋行動表達努力尋找，同時不虛構結果。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 198, row 5; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: She spent Saturday hunting for a repair shop.

options.en: She was actively looking in several places for a cable.
options.zh: 她在幾個地方積極尋找電線。

options.en: She was comparing prices for several types of cable.
options.zh: 她正在比較幾種電線的價格。

options.en: She was arranging a repair for the projector itself.
options.zh: 她正在安排維修投影機本身。

options.en: She was asking suppliers about a backup projector.
options.zh: 她正在向供應商查詢後備投影機。

listening.explanationZh: 她向多個供應商查詢並翻查儲物室，目的是找替換電線；未提及比較價格或維修投影機。
listening.en: The projector stopped working before the talk, so Nora called three suppliers and checked the storeroom. She was hunting for a replacement cable.
listening.zh: 講座前投影機故障，諾拉打電話給三家供應商，又檢查儲物室；她正在積極尋找替換電線。

reply.promptZh: （工作坊的舊打印機壞了，米婭做了甚麼？）

options.en: She called local shops to ask whether they could repair it.
options.zh: 她致電本地店舖，詢問能否維修。

options.en: She searched several directories for a suitable service.
options.zh: 她查閱幾份名錄，尋找合適服務。

options.en: She hunted for a technician who could handle that printer model.
options.zh: 她積極尋找能維修該型號打印機的技師。

options.en: She asked neighbours whether they knew a reliable technician.
options.zh: 她問鄰居是否認識可靠的維修技師。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都可描述尋找維修服務；金句使用本課動詞片語，並沒有聲稱已找到。
reply.promptEn: What did Mia do when the workshop’s old printer failed?

scene.promptZh: 一所小學演出前遺失了特製舞台燈泡；老師翻查儲物箱、致電供應商，再詢問鄰校。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The teacher hunted for a replacement bulb before the performance.
options.zh: 老師在演出前積極尋找替換燈泡。

options.en: The teacher was comparing prices for a complete set of stage lights.
options.zh: 老師正在比較整套舞台燈具的價格。

options.en: The teacher was arranging a lighting test for a later show.
options.zh: 老師正在安排稍後另一場演出的燈光測試。

scene.explanationZh: 老師翻找、致電、詢問鄰校，是在積極尋找眼前演出所需的替換燈泡；沒有比較整套燈具或籌備之後的演出。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不符合 hunt for 的本課意思？

options.en: A student checks several shelves for a missing notebook.
options.zh: 學生翻查幾個書架尋找遺失的筆記本。

options.en: A neighbour phones different stores to locate an uncommon part.
options.zh: 鄰居致電不同店舖尋找少見零件。

options.en: A customer receives the exact part without asking or looking for it.
options.zh: 顧客沒有詢問或尋找，就收到所需零件。

contrast.explanationZh: 完全沒有尋找行動，不適合稱為 hunt for。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「我找不到適合這部舊收音機的零件，但附近或許還有幾間店。」你怎樣回應最自然？

options.en: Let us hunt for the right part by calling those shops before they close.
options.zh: 我們在店舖關門前逐一致電，積極尋找合適零件吧。

options.en: We can make a list of the shops and their opening times.
options.zh: 我們可列出店舖及營業時間。

options.en: I can help you ask which models their parts fit.
options.zh: 我可以幫你詢問零件適用於哪些型號。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句提出具體搜尋方法；另外兩句也是合適協助，但沒有使用本課片語。

speaking.en: They hunted for a spare microphone by calling nearby schools and checking the storage room.
speaking.zh: 他們致電附近學校並查看儲物室，積極尋找備用麥克風。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明他們如何尋找。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：社區放映會前，播放機的遙控器不見了。義工會檢查器材箱、詢問上次使用的團隊，必要時借另一個。用一至兩句英文描述搜尋及備用計劃，不要說已找到。
writing.selfCheckZh: 寫出實際搜尋步驟和可行備案；不要把尚未找到的遙控器說成已找回。

examples.en: The volunteers are hunting for the missing remote by checking the equipment box and asking the last team who used it.
examples.zh: 義工正查看器材箱，並詢問上次使用的團隊，積極尋找遺失的遙控器。

examples.en: They will hunt for the remote first; if it stays missing, they can borrow another one before the screening.
examples.zh: 他們會先積極尋找遙控器；若仍找不到，可在放映前借用另一個。

takeaways.en: We hunted for a spare key in the places where it was last used.
takeaways.zh: 我們在最後使用備用鑰匙的地方積極尋找。

takeaways.en: They are hunting for a replacement part, but they have not found one yet.
takeaways.zh: 他們正積極尋找替換零件，但尚未找到。

lessons.titleZh: 反映某人當下重視甚麼

target.pattern: \ba snapshot of (?:someone[’\x27]s|their|her|his|our|the group[’\x27]s|the club[’\x27]s|the school[’\x27]s|a family[’\x27]s) priorities\b

brief.meaningEn: A limited, momentary view of what someone appears to value, inferred from a particular choice or record.
brief.meaningZh: 從某項選擇或紀錄，看出一個人當下可能重視甚麼的有限片段。
brief.grammar: Use a snapshot of someone’s priorities with evidence; snapshot is partial and time-bound, not a complete personality diagnosis.
brief.register: A teacher, organiser or friend cautiously interpreting a list, budget or choice.
brief.boundaryZh: 只能從有限資料作審慎推測，不可當作完整或永久的人格判斷。
brief.misconceptionZh: 不是實際拍攝的照片，也不能單靠一張清單斷言一生價值觀。
brief.outcomeZh: 能用具體資料作有限推論，並指出它可能漏掉其他因素。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 200, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: A shopping list can be a snapshot of someone's priorities.

listening.promptZh: 這份預算計劃能說明甚麼？

options.en: For this event, accessible transport appears to matter more than decoration.
options.zh: 在這次活動中，無障礙交通似乎比裝飾更重要。

options.en: The club values accessible travel over decoration at every event.
options.zh: 社團在每次活動中都把無障礙交通放在裝飾之前。

options.en: The plan tells us which individual members wanted transport funding.
options.zh: 這份計劃告訴我們哪些個別成員想資助交通。

options.en: The club plans to cut decoration spending in future years.
options.zh: 社團計劃在未來幾年削減裝飾開支。

listening.explanationZh: 預算顯示這次活動較重視無障礙交通；不能推至每次活動、每位成員或未來幾年。
listening.en: The club spent most of its small budget on accessible transport rather than decorations. This plan is a snapshot of the club’s priorities for this event.
listening.zh: 社團把大部分有限預算用在無障礙交通，而非裝飾；這份計劃反映了社團對這次活動的部分優先考量。

reply.promptZh: （這個月的活動預算能讓我們了解籌辦者甚麼？）

options.en: They have allocated more money to transport than to banners.
options.zh: 他們撥給交通的款項比橫額多。

options.en: Their budget is a snapshot of their priorities for this event.
options.zh: 這份預算反映他們對這次活動的部分優先考量。

options.en: They have chosen to fund travel for participants first.
options.zh: 他們選擇優先資助參加者的交通。

options.en: They may be trying to make the venue easier to reach.
options.zh: 他們可能希望讓場地更易到達。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都能根據預算作合理描述；金句明確指出這只是一個當下的片段。
reply.promptEn: What can the event budget tell us about the organisers this month?

scene.promptZh: 社區小組的本月採購單先列出飲水和遮陽設備，再列出宣傳物品。哪句最審慎？

options.en: The list is a snapshot of the group’s priorities for this month, not its whole history.
options.zh: 這張清單只反映小組本月部分優先考量，不代表它的全部歷史。

options.en: The order shows that water and shade always come before publicity in every project.
options.zh: 採購單顯示，在每項計劃中飲水和遮陽設備都一定比宣傳優先。

options.en: The order mainly tells us which items were cheapest this month.
options.zh: 採購單主要告訴我們本月哪些物品最便宜。

scene.explanationZh: 本月清單可反映這段時間的部分優先考量；不能推斷所有項目都一樣，也沒有價格比較資料。

contrast.promptZh: 哪種說法最超出 a snapshot of someone’s priorities 所能支持的範圍？

options.en: A single list may show what mattered for this week’s task.
options.zh: 一張清單或可反映本週任務的重點。

options.en: The budget offers one limited view of the club’s current choices.
options.zh: 預算提供了觀察社團目前選擇的一個有限角度。

options.en: One shopping list proves exactly what the person values for life.
options.zh: 一張購物清單準確證明這個人一生重視甚麼。

contrast.explanationZh: snapshot 是片段；一張清單不能證明終生不變的價值觀。

dialogue.promptZh: 朋友說：「她為活動先買急救用品，再買裝飾，我們可以從中看出甚麼？」你怎樣回答最審慎？

options.en: It is a snapshot of her priorities for this event, though we would need more context to know why.
options.zh: 這反映她對這次活動的部分優先考量，但要知道原因，仍需更多背景。

options.en: She chose first-aid supplies before decorations on this list.
options.zh: 在這張清單上，她先選了急救用品，才選裝飾。

options.en: We could ask her what shaped the order of those purchases.
options.zh: 我們可問她是甚麼影響了購買次序。

dialogue.explanationZh: 金句保留資料的局限；另外兩句也是合適的觀察或下一步。

speaking.en: The volunteer budget offers a snapshot of their priorities for this weekend.
speaking.zh: 義工預算反映了他們對這個週末的部分優先考量。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再說明這份資料能支持多大推論。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：學校園遊會的採購單先列出飲水站和無障礙坡道，最後才列出舞台裝飾。用一至兩句英文審慎描述清單透露的當前重點，並指出它不是對學校所有價值的完整判斷。
writing.selfCheckZh: 從清單提出有限推論；不要把一時的採購次序當成永遠不變的價值觀。

examples.en: The fair’s shopping list is a snapshot of the school’s priorities for this event: drinking water and step-free access come before stage decorations.
examples.zh: 園遊會採購單反映學校對這次活動的部分優先考量：飲水和無障礙通道排在舞台裝飾之前。

examples.en: This budget gives a snapshot of their priorities today, with access and water near the top, but it cannot describe everything the school values.
examples.zh: 這份預算反映他們今天的部分優先考量，無障礙設施和飲水排在前列，但它不能說明學校重視的所有事情。

takeaways.en: A spending plan can be a snapshot of their priorities for one project.
takeaways.zh: 一份開支計劃可以反映他們對某個項目的部分優先考量。

takeaways.en: The list gives a snapshot of her priorities today, not a complete account of her values.
takeaways.zh: 這張清單反映她今天的部分優先考量，並不是對她價值觀的完整描述。
